index.title:
A gargoyle
rarely comes alone
index.description-before: Whether they're animals, people, or monsters, discover more than
index.text: You can get to know 17 of them on an augmented reality tour.
index.swipe: Swipe left to proceed to the next step.
index.manual-first-step-text: Find a suitable wall at the cathedral and point your camera at it.
index.manual-second-step-text: Scan the wall surface until the 3D model appears.
index.manual-third-step-text: Tap the info button to learn more about the gargoyle.
index.first-tip: Look for symbols, inscriptions, or conspicuous areas of rock.
index.second-tip: The 3D models are always hidden on flat walls, not in corners or along edges.
index.third-tip: From the scanning position, you can spot the stone gargoyle above you.
index.fourth-tip: To help you find your way around, just take a look at the map — it shows you where the gargoyle models are hidden.
index.notice-text: Due to construction or events on Münsterplatz, some hiding spots may be temporarily inaccessible. Just visit these gargoyles at a later time.
index.camera-access-text: The AR app requires access to your camera. When you launch it, your browser will ask for your permission. Allow camera access so that the app can work.
